name: BarChart.data
description: Data array - each item should have an x-axis key and numeric values

name: BarChart.xDataKey
description: Key in data for the categorical axis. Default: "name"

name: BarChart.margin
description: Chart margins

name: BarChart.animationDuration
description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1100

name: BarChart.animationEasing
description: CSS easing for bar grow transitions.

name: BarChart.enterTransition
description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

name: BarChart.revealSignature
description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers enter replay when it changes.

name: BarChart.aspectRatio
description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

name: BarChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: BarChart.barGap
description: Gap between bar groups as a fraction of band width (0-1). Default: 0.2

name: BarChart.barWidth
description: Fixed bar width in pixels. If not set, bars auto-size to fill the band.

name: BarChart.orientation
description: Bar chart orientation. Default: "vertical"

name: BarChart.stacked
description: Whether to stack bars instead of grouping them. Default: false

name: BarChart.stackGap
description: Gap between stacked bar segments in pixels. Default: 0

name: BarChart.squareSnap
type: { squareGap: number; groupGap?: number; fit?: boolean }
description: When set, tooltip Y positions snap to the top square center (shape variant).

name: BarChart.children
description:
Child components (Bar, Grid, ChartTooltip, etc.). Optional — omit for a
pure `status="loading"` skeleton.

name: BarChart.onPhaseChange
description: Reports reveal lifecycle for OG screenshots and loading orchestration.

name: BarChart.status
description:
Fetch / display status. When `"loading"`, a shimmer skeleton replaces the
bars (no chart data required). Default: `"ready"`.

name: BarChart.keyboardNavigation
description: Enable chart keyboard inspection. Disable when a parent owns keyboard input. Default: true

name: Bar.dataKey
description: Key in data to use for y values

name: Bar.yAxisId
description: Y-scale group id for vertical bars (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

name: Bar.fill
description: Fill color for the bar. Can be a color, gradient url, or pattern url. Default: var(--chart-1)

name: Bar.fillForDatum
description: Optional fill per datum, for selection or categorical state.

name: Bar.stroke
description: Color for tooltip dot. Use when fill is a gradient/pattern. Default: uses fill value

name: Bar.lineCap
description: Line cap style for bar ends: "round", "butt", or a number for custom radius. Default: "round"

name: Bar.animate
description: Whether to animate the bars. Default: true

name: Bar.animationType
description: Animation type: "grow" (height) or "fade" (opacity + blur). Default: "grow"

name: Bar.fadedOpacity
description: Opacity when not hovered (when another bar is hovered). Default: 0.3

name: Bar.staggerDelay
description: Stagger delay between bars in seconds. Auto-calculated if not provided.

name: Bar.stackGap
description: Gap between stacked bars in pixels. Default: 0

name: Bar.groupGap
description: Gap between grouped bars in pixels. Default: 4

name: Bar.perspective
description:
Shrink each positive bar's top by its perspective rise so the front face
lines up with `<BarDepthBack>`'s lid (instead of the lid sitting above the
front face). Pass `true` whenever the chart also renders the bar-depth 3D
surfaces. Default: false

name: Bar.minBarHeight
description:
Minimum rendered bar height in px (non-stacked, vertical). Floors short or
zero-value bars so they stay visible. Pair with the same value on
`<BarDepthProvider minBarHeight>` when using the 3D surfaces. Default: 0

name: BarSquares.dataKey
description: Required composition API.

name: BarSquares.yAxisId
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarSquares.fill
description: Fill color, gradient url, or pattern url. Default: var(--chart-1)

name: BarSquares.stroke
description: Tooltip dot / ring stroke color when fill is gradient/pattern

name: BarSquares.squareGap
description: Gap between stacked squares in pixels. Default: 3

name: BarSquares.squareRadius
description: Corner radius as a fraction of square size (0 = flat, 0.5 = circle). Default: 0.25

name: BarSquares.squareFit
description: Redistribute gap so columns fit bar height exactly

name: BarSquares.useGradient
description: Apply bar-spanning gradient from gradientStops

name: BarSquares.gradientStops
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarSquares.patternPreset
description: Pattern preset when fill is a pattern (for gradient tinting)

name: BarSquares.animate
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarSquares.fadedOpacity
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarSquares.staggerDelay
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarSquares.groupGap
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarColumnTrack.fill
description: Fill color or pattern url. Default: var(--border)

name: BarColumnTrack.opacity
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarColumnTrack.squareGap
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarColumnTrack.squareRadius
description: Corner radius fraction (matches squares). Default: 0.25

name: BarColumnTrack.groupGap
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarColumnTrack.squareFit
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarColumnTrack.staggerDelay
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarDepthProvider.children
description: Required composition API.

name: BarDepthProvider.segmentsAccessor
type: ( datum: Record<string, unknown> ) => BarDepthSegment[] | null | undefined
description: Optional composition API.

name: BarDepthProvider.groundShadow
description: Opacity (0–1) of the baseline contact shadow. 0 removes it.

name: BarDepthProvider.minBarHeight
description:
Minimum bar height in px — floors short/zero bars so they stay visible.
Match the value passed to `<Bar minBarHeight>`.

name: BarDepthBack.dataKey
description: Key in data for the bar value. Match the sibling `<Bar dataKey>`.

name: BarDepthBack.color
description: Solid color for the side + top faces. Default: var(--chart-1).

name: BarDepthBack.colorAccessor
description: Per-bar color override; takes precedence over `color` when provided.

name: BarDepthFront.dataKey
description: Key in data for the bar value. Match the sibling `<Bar dataKey>`.

name: BarPulse.dataKey
description: Key in data for the bar value. Match the sibling `<Bar dataKey>`.

name: BarPulse.activeIndex
description: Index (in the data array) of the bar to pulse.

name: BarPulse.pulsePaused
description: Suppress the sweep while keeping the bar's 3D + glass treatment.

name: BarChartLoading.margin
description: Chart margins.

name: BarChartLoading.aspectRatio
description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

name: BarChartLoading.className
description: Additional class name for the container.

name: BarXAxis.formatLabel
description: Format category labels without changing category identity or ordering.

name: BarXAxis.tickerHalfWidth
description: Width of the date ticker box for fade calculation. Default: 50

name: BarXAxis.showAllLabels
description: Whether to show all labels or skip some for dense data. Default: false

name: BarXAxis.maxLabels
description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 12

name: BarYAxis.showAllLabels
description: Whether to show all labels or skip some for dense data. Default: true

name: BarYAxis.maxLabels
description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 20
